content: Smoothed 1-4 character n-gram statistics only; no sentence text is packaged.

sources.name: Mozilla Common Voice sentence text (zh-CN, zh-TW)
Bundled dictionary words (internal n-grams only, no clause boundaries)

processing: Traditional text converted to simplified Chinese with OpenCC t2s (tw2sp for zh-TW).
Wikinews markup removed; interwiki link labels kept.
Text split into clauses of Han characters; each clause wrapped in sentence boundary markers.
One line in forty (SHA-256 of its text) held out; held-out Tatoeba and Common Voice lines form tests/data/heldout_*.tsv.
Clauses containing any evaluation sentence of four or more characters are excluded.
Interpolated modified Kneser-Ney estimation; count cutoffs 1/2/3/4 for orders 1-4; pruned rows renormalized.
build_command: python tools/build_context_lm.py --input resources/dictionary/authoring/daily_*.txt:8 <other authoring .txt>:1 <work>/train/wikinews.txt:1 <work>/train/tatoeba.txt:3 <work>/train/cv.txt:3 --fragments resources/dictionary/local_core_zh_pinyin.tsv:2 resources/dictionary/standard_zh_pinyin.tsv:2 resources/dictionary/core_zh_pinyin.tsv:2 --exclude tests/data/typing_holdout.tsv tests/data/typing_fresh.tsv tests/data/typing_independent.tsv tests/data/scenario_replay_076.tsv tests/data/common_word_order_079.tsv tests/data/heldout_sentences.tsv --min-count 1 2 3 4 --output resources/dictionary/context_zh.lm
